desc: Strike of the Hydra: Aku'mai's famous two-handed sword from World of Warcraft: a long two-handed sword with a wavy deep teal-blue blade patterned like hydra scales and a serpent-head crossguard

Heart of Agamaggan: Charlga Razorflank's famous shield from World of Warcraft: a round shield made of a great boar's hide stretched over wood, with a boar skull and tusks in the middle and thorny bristles round the rim
